video_title: Training Camp Media Availability (9/30/26) | LA Clippers

quotes.speaker: Tyronn Lue
quotes.text: We are a smaller team. We are definitely a smaller team in height and size. We have to be tough minded and tough every night without rebounding the basketball every night and we have to bring a physicality to rebound the ball.
quotes.pull_quote: We are a smaller team. We are definitely a smaller team in height and size.
quotes.news_angle: Tyronn Lue acknowledges the Clippers are a smaller team and must focus on physicality to rebound.
quotes.social_post: Tyronn Lue says the Clippers are a smaller team this season and must focus on physical play to win the rebounding battle.

quotes.speaker: Kai Jones
quotes.text: Everybody say that we underdog in everything right now but we have the mindset that we know what we can do. I expect big things. He has been playing very comfortable coming off pick and roll, getting downhill, making plays for others and himself. He has just been playing tremendous on offense.
quotes.pull_quote: Everybody say that we underdog in everything right now but we have the mindset
quotes.news_angle: Kai Jones believes the Clippers have the right mindset to overcome underdog status.
quotes.social_post: Kai Jones says the Clippers have the right mindset to overcome their underdog status this season.

quotes.speaker: Terance Mann
quotes.text: One thing I learned about Keaton that he processes things very fast. He has a very high IQ and he has been playing really well since I have landed in California and even in training camp yesterday I thought he played well.
quotes.pull_quote: One thing I learned about Keaton that he processes things very fast.
quotes.news_angle: Terance Mann praises Keaton for his high basketball IQ and fast processing speed.
quotes.social_post: Terance Mann says Keaton has a very high basketball IQ and processes the game very fast.
